translation.name: Godɨn Eghaghanim: Akar Gavgavir Dɨkɨrɨzir Ghurim ko Igiam

book.name: Rom
book.title: Akɨnafarir Pol Romɨn Nguibar Ekiamɨn Itir Sios Bagha Osirizim O Rom

content: Israelia Godɨn Araziba deravɨra dagh fozir puvatɨ
Nan adarasi, God ua Israelia iniasa kɨ uan navir averiamɨn aven bar ifuegha, me bagha God ko mɨgei.
Kɨ bar deragha Israelia gɨfogha kamaghɨn mɨgei, me Godɨn Arazibar gɨn mangasa bar gavgafi. Egha me guizɨn God ifongezir arazim gɨfozir puvatɨ.

Me, tuavir God ghaze e an damazimɨn derazim, me a gɨfozir puvatɨ. Egha uan gavgavibar, Godɨn damazimɨn deraghasa tuaviba buri. Kamaghɨn amizɨ me Godɨn damazimɨn deraghamin tuavimɨn apengan itir puvatɨ.
E fo, Krais Moses Osirizir Arazibagh amizɨma, dar gavgavim gɨfa. Kamaghɨn, tina nɨghnɨzir gavgavim Kraisɨn iti, anarɨra Godɨn damazimɨn deragham.

Gumazamizir Godɨn damazimɨn deraghasa Moses Osirizir Arazibar gɨn zuiba, Moses me mɨgɨa kamaghɨn osiri, “Gumazamiziba Moses Osirizir Araziba mɨgei moghɨn damu egh dughiaba zurara dar amutɨ, arazir kaba me damutɨ, me ikɨvɨra ikiam.”

Kar Godɨn Akɨnafarimɨn akar otevir mam, a gumazamizir nɨghnɨzir gavgavimɨn tuavimɨn Godɨn damazimɨn deraziba, a kamaghɨn me mɨgei, “Ia uan navir averiabar kamaghɨn mɨkɨmam markɨ, ‘Tina Godɨn Nguibamɨn ghuavanangam?’ ” (Akar kam kamakɨn, nɨ Krais e bagh izighirɨsɨ, nɨ mangɨva an azangam?)
“Egh nɨ uaghan kamaghɨn mɨkɨman markɨ, ‘Tina Gumazamizir Oveaghuezibar Nguibamɨn magɨram?’ ” (Akar kam kamakɨn, nɨ ovevemɨn mozimɨn mangɨ, Krais inigh anangam?)
Ezɨ Godɨn Akɨnafarim kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Godɨn akam bar nɨn boroghɨra iti, a nɨn akatorim ko nɨn navir averiamɨn aven iti.” Kar nɨghnɨzir gavgavimɨn akar e ia mɨgeim.

Nɨ uan akamɨn kamaghɨn mɨkɨm suam, “Iesus a nan Ekiam,” egh uan navir averiamɨn aven nɨghnɨzir gavgavim ikɨ, kamaghɨn fogh, God Iesus gamizɨ a mozimɨn ua dɨkafi, eghtɨ God nɨn akurvaghtɨ, nɨ ikɨvɨra ikiam.
E fo, nɨ navir averiamɨn nɨghnɨzir gavgavim Iesusɨn ikɨtɨ, God suam, nɨ nan damazimɨn dera. Egh uaghan nɨ uan akatorimɨn suam, “Iesus nan Ekiam,” eghtɨ God nɨn akuraghtɨ, nɨ ikɨvɨra ikiam.
Godɨn Akɨnafarim kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Gumazamiziba nɨghnɨzir gavgavim an itiba, me aghumsɨghan kogham. Puvatɨ.”

Godɨn Akɨnafarim ghaze, “Ekiamɨn ziamɨn diaghamin adarasi, a men akurvagham.” Kamaghɨn amizɨ, Godɨn vamɨra iti, a bar en Ekiam. Eghtɨ gumazamizir an deiba, a bar bizir aghuir avɨriba men akurvagham. Judaba ko Kantrin Igharazibar Gumazamiziba, Godɨn damazimɨn magh gari.

Ezɨ manmakɨn? Gumazamizir nɨghnɨzir gavgavim Godɨn itir puvatɨziba, me manmaghɨn an ziamɨn dɨmam? Egh gumazamizir eghaghanim baraghizir puvatɨziba, me manmaghɨn nɨghnɨzir gavgavim an ikiam? Eghtɨ gumazamizitaba Akar Aghuim me mɨkɨnighan koghtɨ, me manmaghɨn a baregham?

Eghtɨ siosba Akar Aghuim akurir gumazamiziba amangan koghtɨma, me manmaghɨn akamɨn gun me mɨkɨmam? Godɨn Akɨnafarimɨn aven Aisaia kamaghɨn osiri, “Godɨn Akar Aghuim inigha izir gumazamizibar darorim, a bar dera.”
Israelia Akar Aghuim inizir puvatɨ
Ezɨ Israelian marasi me Godɨn Akar Aghuim inizir puvatɨ. Aisaia uabɨ kamaghɨn mɨgei, “Ekiam, tinara en Akar Aghuim nɨghnɨzir gavgavim an iti?”
Kamaghɨn e fo, nɨghnɨzir gavgavim a gumazamiziba Akar Aghuim barazir tuavimɨn izam. Eghtɨ gumazamizir Kraisɨn akam akuribar tuavimɨn, gumazamiziba Akar Aghuim baregham.
Ezɨ kɨ ian azai, Israelɨn gumazamiziba me Godɨn Akar Aghuim, me uan kuaribar a baraghizir puvatɨ, o? Kɨ ghaze, me guizbangɨra oraki. E fo, Godɨn Akɨnafarim kamaghɨn mɨgei:

content.text: “Akam inigha izir gumazibar akatoribar otivir mɨgɨrɨgɨaba,
da ghua nguazir kamɨn nguibaba bar dar otozɨ,
gumazamiziba bar, men kuariba a baraki.”

content: Ezɨ kɨ ua ian azai, Israelia me ti akar kamɨn mɨngarim gɨfozir puvatɨ, o? Puvatɨ. Me fos. Moses God bagha faragha kamaghɨn mɨkeme:

content.text: “Kɨ Kantrin Igharazibar Gumazamizir ziaba puvatɨgha pura bizibar mɨn itiba kɨ me inightɨma,
